content:
As Amazon's fall Prime Day early deals kick off, and alongside this morning's highly notable $500 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal, today's 9to5Toys afternoon roundup leads with up to $513 off iPhone 17 Pro Max models, offering far better value than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium). We also have ecobee's official fall Prime Day HomeKit deals officially underway, with smart thermostats, bundles, and more discounted up to $210, plus a lineup of Apple accessories deals: Solo Loop bands at $7 each or less, rare $100 off official Magic Keyboard Folio, and 40% off official MagSafe battery. Below you'll find plenty more deals on chargers, TVs, smart speakers, and more.

Amazon is now offering up to $513 off iPhone 17 Pro Max models, far better value than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium)

We've had a few opportunities to pick up solid iPhone 17 Pro deals directly from Amazon before, but with fall Prime Day early deals now underway, we're seeing the first significant discounts on unlocked Renewed Premium models. Although the iPhone 18 Pro Max is already on sale, you can now step down to the 17 Pro and save over $500 on comparable specs. More below.

You can now grab this 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max for $1,385.78 with free shipping. That's $213 below the original new price and a whopping $513 cheaper than Apple's official 1TB 18 Pro Max.

Apple only launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month at $1,899, and while the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't debut at that same level, you can now enjoy a solid discount through Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed inventory.

Only the Deep Blue model is currently available at this price directly from Amazon, but other models remain priced well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max's retail:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (originally $1,599)

Apple's official refurbished store hasn't started selling the iPhone 17 series yet, and what we're seeing here are Amazon's highest-quality refurbished models with the full Amazon Renewed 1-year warranty promise and a "battery life exceeding 90% of original" guarantee — these aren't your typical refurb units.

Here's what's currently available for the Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro lineup:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon in both Silver and Space Black

The latest M5 MacBook Air is still seeing plenty of deals, but we want to revisit Amazon's $500 off this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal — both Space Black and Silver are available at this price.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the same all-time low price we've been tracking for the past few months, but now both Space Black and Silver are in stock — the latter doesn't typically hit this price as often as the black model.

Apple Solo Loop clearance sale kicks off: $7 each, 2-pack for $10, 3-pack for $15 (originally from $49)

To coincide with fall Prime Day early deals, Woot has just launched a full clearance sale on official Apple Braided Solo Loop and Solo Loop bands. Each band is now just $6.99 with free shipping for Prime members, and you can take an additional 30% off at checkout when buying "2 or more."

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but never at prices this low. Colors and sizes are expected to sell out fast, and at these prices, if you've had your eye on a few specific styles, it's worth grabbing a couple.

Solo Loops typically retail for $49, so even a single band is a great deal. But grabbing 2 or more with the extra 30% off is an absolute steal:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (originally from $49)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (originally from $98)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (originally from $147)

Colors and sizes are already starting to sell out, so we'll keep this brief — grab them while they're still available.

iPad Apple Magic Keyboard Folio sees rare $100 discount at Amazon

ecobee's official fall Prime Day HomeKit deals officially underway: smart thermostats, bundles, and more up to $210 off

We're still in the early stages of fall Prime Day, but deals are pouring in, and ecobee has notified 9to5Toys that its official Prime Big Deal Days promotion is now live. From today through October 7, its popular HomeKit smart thermostats and bundles are on sale, saving you over $200.

ecobee's official fall Prime Day deals are officially live

These deal pages don't yet show the official Prime Day badge, but the prices already reflect official fall Prime Day discounts, many of which match what we tracked during the summer Prime Day event. Outside of major seasonal sales throughout the year, this brand rarely sees discounts this deep and comprehensive, so if you've been looking to upgrade your smart home, now's the time while these deals last.

Nearly all full bundle pricing matches — or is even lower than — what we tracked during the summer Prime Day official event.

All-new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K launches today with 50% off, other models from $16

To coincide with the ongoing fall Prime Day early deals, Amazon today launched the all-new Fire TV Stick 4K, and you can get 50% off the launch price by clipping the on-page coupon or using code 4KINTRO at checkout. This big launch deal joins the fall Prime Day early deals lineup, which covers the Fire TV Stick and streaming device lineup starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick fall Prime Day early deals:

  • All-new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K: $30 (originally $60)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick HD: $16 (originally $40)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Wi-Fi 6E: $45 (originally $85)

  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus, Wi-Fi 6: $36 (originally $70)

Amazon is now selling the all-new Fire TV Stick 4K with the upgraded Fire TV remote for $29.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

Don't forget to clip the on-page coupon or use code 4KINTRO at checkout.

Amazon just unveiled a massive lineup of upcoming fall Prime Day deals

All-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals return to Amazon (up to $50 off)

Alongside this morning's massive $500 off 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal, Amazon has simultaneously reinstated all launch deals on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

The 2026 Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip, as well as the higher-end M5 Pro model available from Amazon, are now both selling at all-time low prices:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (originally $1,699)

The all-new Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and 512GB built-in storage is also $50 off:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (originally $2,499)

Strictly speaking these discounts aren't massive, but for users looking to upgrade early in the product cycle, Amazon is now the cheapest place to grab them, with all available configurations back at their all-time lows. As the new work week kicks off, we wanted to make sure you don't miss these deals.
